Young Woman's Voice: Look, I know that you're running out of shelf space, but you really shouldn't put things on the hearth. There's a whole box of paper towels here for no reason!

And don't get me started on the stuff in the cookpit!

Reigen: Well I don't put it there on purpose! I'm in the living room, and I need some place to put things, and it sort of happens.

Also I was trying to keep round things together. Round circle, round things. And Sock's helmet is round.

I have a whole system based on word association.
